entities.name: Marian Costea
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Marian Costea was a Romanian ice hockey player. He played for the Romanian national team at the 1976 Winter Olympics in Innsbruck, and the 1980 Winter Olympics in Lake Placid. Costea died on 10 April 2024, at the age of 71.
